channel.title: Tozi Packaging: Custom Apparel Boxes
channel.description: Custom Apparel Boxes from Tozi Packaging

item.title: White Apparel Boxes
item.description: Clean white board against tissue paper, a logo pressed into the surface with just enough depth to catch the light, a lid that lifts with controlled resistance and reveals a folded garment sitting exactly where it was placed. That sequence of moments is a brand experience that your customer will replay in their mind, and white apparel boxes give you the clearest possible canvas to make it happen.

item.title: 2 Piece Apparel Boxes
item.description: The moment a lid lifts cleanly from a base, resisting just enough to signal quality, and a folded garment appears beneath tissue paper that has been placed with care, the entire perception of your brand shifts upward in real time. That controlled reveal is not accidental. It is architectural. It is what 2 piece apparel boxes deliver that no mailer format, no poly bag, and no folding carton can replicate.

item.title: Apparel Gift Boxes
item.description: Lifting a lid to find a garment folded with precision, wrapped in tissue, sitting inside a box that feels as considered as the clothing itself, tells the recipient they are holding something that was chosen deliberately. That moment of recognition, the weight of the box, the resistance of the lid, the reveal of the fabric beneath, is a brand experience your product alone cannot manufacture. Apparel gift boxes make it possible.
